haiku-aa-cost-provisional.label: Haiku AA cost excludes long-input tier in the captured evaluation
haiku-aa-cost-provisional.note: Do not assume per-request input tier from aggregate output tokens; require an identifiable updated evaluation/cost reconstruction.

haiku-aa-automation-prerelease.label: Haiku prerelease over-refusal affected AutomationBench
haiku-aa-automation-prerelease.note: A promised rerun is not a completed reevaluation.

nan-variant-unverified.label: NaN endpoint/checkpoint correspondence remains conditional
nan-variant-unverified.note: Model evidence may be shown as candidate context, not measured NaN quality.

opaque-protocol.label: Protocol not fully structured in the old observation
opaque-protocol.note: Inspect original source before causal or cross-source comparison.

unknown-metric.label: Metric semantics unresolved
unknown-metric.note: A numeric observation is not necessarily a capability score.

local-summary-unverified.label: Local summary not directly reconciled to an exact primary cell
local-summary-unverified.note: Keep as secondary context; do not silently promote a prose estimate.

legacy-osworld-version-disputed.label: Versión OSWorld de un resumen anterior requiere reconciliación
legacy-osworld-version-disputed.note: La cifra estricta de Opus 48.7 en la system card Sonnet corresponde a 2.1 full. No usar la etiqueta secundaria 2.0 como protocolo confirmado; el resultado primario se incorpora separado.

aa-benchmark-under-review.label: AA señala SciCode y CritPt como Under review
aa-benchmark-under-review.note: Estado observado en la página primaria de AA el 2026-10-10. Conservar las celdas históricas; no utilizarlas para admitir candidatas ni inferir validez científica.

harnessrank-historical-harness.label: HarnessRank report evaluates historical harness versions, not the current Agent Profile Lab targets
harnessrank-historical-harness.note: Aggregates for GPT-5.5 medium, Pi v0.79.6, OMP v16.1.15, OpenCode v1.17.9 and Codex v0.130.0. Valid source-local historical comparison, never a direct comparison of the user’s current installed harnesses.
